faqs.question: Why WooCommerce over a hosted platform?
faqs.answer: It gives you full ownership, no per-sale platform fees, and unlimited customization — ideal when you want control and a content-rich site alongside the store.

faqs.question: Is it secure and reliable?
faqs.answer: Yes — we handle secure hosting, backups, updates, and performance so the store stays fast and safe.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
